conversion: R table exported as CSV; R Date days since 1970-01-01 converted to ISO date strings; no measured values changed. Coordinate table exported from locmaps$p24d2. Excluded points l26/l35 identified by the source map's bs component (R 1-based).
coordinate_convention: The package stores locations in a common right-eye coordinate frame. Original vfplots.R mirrors x-axis display for OS without reordering sensitivity columns. Preserve this convention during modelling; mirror only the displayed x coordinate for OS if showing actual left-eye field orientation.
caveats: All participants have glaucoma; no healthy class or progression labels.
The study assumes little clinically meaningful short-term change.
Published dates include a 524-day span for subject 7 despite a study description of 12 weekly sessions.
All published fpr values are zero; time/duration are placeholder-like constants.
A prediction target is the next recorded test, not guaranteed one week later.
